hero.intro: The V-Class is the premium minivan of the Prestigo fleet: six individual seats, full luggage for every passenger and a cabin that keeps a family, a board or a group of friends together in one car. A professional driver, one fixed fare, from Prague Airport to the door or across Central Europe.

intro.headingLine1: One car for the whole party,
paragraphs: A family of five with suitcases, four colleagues heading to a conference, a group with skis or golf bags — this is where a sedan stops working and the V-Class begins. It seats up to six adults in individual captain chairs and takes six large cases plus six cabin bags in its 1,410-litre cargo area.

Everyone travels together, arrives together and has their own seat, light and charging point. For parents, child and booster seats are fitted before pickup at no extra charge — just tell us ages and weights when you book.
Every Prestigo V-Class is a V 300 d Extralong AVANTGARDE, 2025 model year or newer, black with leather seats, and prepared before every journey.

items.title: Six captain seats
items.body: Individual seats in a face-to-face layout, so a group can talk, plan or simply rest on the way.

items.title: Full luggage for six
items.body: Six large cases plus six cabin bags. Skis, golf bags or a pushchair fit too — just mention them at booking.

items.title: Fold-out table
items.body: A table between the seats for a laptop, documents or a quick briefing before the meeting.

items.title: Privacy
items.body: Rear privacy glass as standard and a privacy partition available on request.

items.title: Wi-Fi and charging
items.body: Enterprise-grade 5G Wi-Fi with no data cap, plus USB-C and USB-A fast charging within reach of every seat.

items.title: Families welcome
items.body: EU-certified child and booster seats installed free of charge, and individual reading lights for the long drives.

steps.label: How it works
steps.heading: Booking a V-Class in four steps.

items.title: Choose the V-Class
items.body: Enter the pickup, destination and time, then select the V-Class. The fare is fixed per vehicle, not per person.

items.title: Tell us who is travelling
items.body: Add the number of passengers, luggage, any skis or golf bags, and child seat ages if needed.

items.title: Meet your driver
items.body: You receive the driver’s name and phone number in advance. At the airport they wait inside the Arrivals hall with a name board.

items.title: Travel together
items.body: The driver loads every bag. Your group stays together from the terminal to the door.

editorial.label: Where the V-Class goes
paragraphs: Airport transfers from Václav Havel Airport include flight tracking, a name board in the Arrivals hall and up to 60 minutes of free waiting — useful when six people clear passport control at different speeds. Hourly hire keeps the V-Class with you for a day in the city or a trip to Kutná Hora or Karlovy Vary.

For intercity travel — Vienna, Munich, Dresden, Český Krumlov and more — fixed-price routes include tolls and vignettes. Travelling with more than six? Our group transfer service coordinates several V-Class vans for up to 50 passengers, with one dispatch contact.

faqs.q: How many passengers and suitcases fit in the Mercedes V-Class?
faqs.a: The V-Class seats up to 6 passengers in individual captain chairs and carries 6 large suitcases plus 6 cabin bags in its 1,410-litre cargo area. It is the right choice for families, groups and anyone travelling with a lot of luggage.

faqs.q: Can I book a minivan with driver from Prague Airport?
faqs.a: Yes. Select the V-Class when you book your airport transfer. Your driver tracks the flight, waits inside the Arrivals hall with a name board and includes up to 60 minutes of free waiting after landing.

faqs.q: Do you provide child seats in the V-Class?
faqs.a: Yes, free of charge. We carry EU-certified infant, toddler and booster seats and install the right ones before pickup — just give each child’s age and weight when you book.

faqs.q: Can the V-Class carry skis, golf bags or a pushchair?
faqs.a: Yes. The V-Class is the only car in our fleet that takes bulky items comfortably. Mention them at booking so the driver can plan the loading.

faqs.q: What if our group is larger than six people?
faqs.a: Book several vehicles through our group transfer service. We coordinate V-Class vans for groups of up to 50 passengers, with synchronised arrivals and a single dispatch contact.

faqs.q: Can I hire the V-Class by the hour or for a trip to another city?
faqs.a: Yes. Hourly hire has a 2-hour minimum. Fixed-price routes from Prague to Vienna, Munich, Dresden and other cities include tolls and vignettes, and the fare is per vehicle, not per person.

faqs.q: What is included in a V-Class booking?
faqs.a: A professional driver, meet and greet with a name board, flight tracking and free waiting at the airport, Wi-Fi, fast charging, still and sparkling water, and child seats on request. Tolls and vignettes are included on intercity routes.
